This system helps us manage demand fairly, improves access to appointments, and reduces waiting times on the phone.
Even with the new process, no patient should ever feel dismissed. I will raise your feedback with the team to make sure information is given in a supportive and respectful way. Every patient should feel able to ask for help without feeling judged.
Thank you again for bringing this to us. Your feedback helps us improve how we communicate with patients.
Regards
Stuart Hall, Practice Manager

Accessing appointments
•	Our online medical request form opens at 8:00am and stays open until we reach the safe daily capacity set to make sure every request is reviewed the same working day. When that capacity is reached, the form temporarily closes and re opens the next working day at 8:00am. Administrative requests remain available, and our phone lines and reception are open for urgent queries until 18:30. 
•	If you struggle with online forms or prefer speaking to someone, our reception team can complete the form with you over the phone or at the desk—this has been our process since moving to Accurx triage. 

Urgent issues
•	The online triage is designed for routine problems; if something feels urgent, please call us so a member of the team can escalate to the duty clinician the same day. (The system also advises using 111/A&E only where appropriate.) 

Your call experience
•	I’m very concerned by your report that a receptionist hung up on you. That is not acceptable and falls short of our standards for courtesy and support. We take conduct seriously and follow clear policies and training to ensure respectful behaviour at all times.

Thank you again for raising this, we will use your feedback to improve how we support patients, particularly those who prefer to book by phone or need extra help.

Kind regards,
